title: aider_shim proves its no-bus surface asks inference_domain over a reach bus
intention: aider_shim's interceptor, built with no bus and no injected door (aider's venv subprocess), builds one bus through bus_client.inference_bus on first need and asks inference_domain get (models) then resolve on it, as sender aider_shim (ticket 87a7f1c7ae21). Today that is measured only from cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_inference_rides_the_bus.py:86,116,117, which imports aider_shim's interceptor and fence, a RULE 1 breach. aider_shim's own proof holds it here, so the bus machine's copy can leave.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: encapsulation_holds names cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_inference_rides_the_bus.py:86,116,117 (cairn.devices.aider_shim.fence, .interceptor). RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only that component, so aider_shim's no-bus tooth berths with aider_shim before the bus machine drops its copy.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1 (a device's public interface is the bus plus any tool it publishes); outline 17.13.1.
how: New proof cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_the_no_bus_surface_asks_over_a_reach_bus.py swaps bus_client.inference_bus (a published tool) for a recording bus that answers get/models with the fence's first model and resolve with a scripted reply inside the fence's provider, builds interceptor.build(fence=, log=) with no bus, and completes one message: exactly one bus is built, the verbs are get then resolve, every sender is aider_shim, resolve carries the model, and aider reads 'pong'. No code change.

clauses.claim: built with no bus and no door, aider_shim's surface builds exactly one reach bus and asks inference_domain get then resolve on it, as sender aider_shim, carrying the model
the reply the bus returned is the reply aider reads

decisions.text: D1: aider_shim's no-bus tooth berths with aider_shim; the bus machine's copy leaves in its own ticket.
